# Thesaurus.com

> A comprehensive online thesaurus providing synonyms, antonyms, and word references to help writers find the perfect word for any context.

Thesaurus.com is a leading language resource offering extensive synonym and antonym listings, writing tips, grammar guides, and vocabulary-building tools. The site serves writers, students, and language enthusiasts with detailed word references, usage examples, and educational content about effective communication.

## Core Thesaurus Tools

- [Synonyms and Antonyms of Words | Thesaurus.com](https://www.thesaurus.com/?writing_prompt=Two+people+have+just+gotten+into+an+argument!+Describe+who+they+are+and+what+they’re+arguing+about+within+the+dialogue.): Homepage with writing prompts, word games, and thesaurus search

## Word Reference Pages

- [COMMUNICATION Synonyms & Antonyms - 128 words](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/communication): 128 synonyms and antonyms for 'communication' with example sentences
- [EMOTIONAL Synonyms & Antonyms - 91 words](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/emotional): 91 synonyms and antonyms for 'emotional' with related words
- [UNFORTUNATELY Synonyms & Antonyms - 22 words](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/unfortunately): 22 synonyms and antonyms for adverb 'unfortunately' with examples
